text:
sam: Notes from standup - two canaries rolled back today due to short latency spikes. Want to avoid immediate evicts.
anya: agreed. we need a bounded forgiveness budget per canary.
carlos: is this per-variant or per-rollout?
sam: default per-variant, but add optional shared_budget for multi-arm tests.
leo: implementation question: local shim only or central ledger?
sam: hybrid: local fast-path with periodic reconcile. central is authoritative for safety.
anya: what about network partitions? prefer configurable fail-open vs fail-closed.
sam: yep tenant-level policy. default hosted = fail-open, enterprise = fail-closed.
carlos: signals -> separate latency vs quality. latency gets softer penalties.
ops-bot: deploy: canary-budget prototype pushed to canary-cluster at 1761112400.
leo: telemetry needed: budget_gauge, penalty_events, reconcile_events, evict_reasons.
sam: tests: short spike (30s), jittery latency, sustained regression. QA to add chaos jobs.
anya: sounds good. i'll pair with sam on RFC draft this week. end.
